name: Khan Jehn
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.

You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.

Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?

<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>

This is why.
narrative.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village.

chain.subtitle: 15 quests from level 32 to 43, 36,630 XP in all.

quests.name: Brutal Politics
quests.objectiveText: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.

quests.name: Assault on the Kolkar
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram.

quests.name: Magram Alliance
quests.objectiveText: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.

quests.name: Broken Tears
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village.

quests.name: A Conqueror's Crown
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.

quests.name: Valley of Bones
quests.objectiveText: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.

quests.name: Mountain of Bones
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 426 Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul south of the Magram Village in Desolace.

quests.name: Corrupting Tears
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Petrified Bark and 3 Imbued Tears back to Orgrul.

quests.name: Proof of Concept
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring 426 Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul.

quests.name: Bone Raising
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: No Mercy for the Weak
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and slay 5 Gelkis Captives scattered around the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Bristleback Retreat
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat.

quests.name: Long-Term Solutions
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram clan and slay 2 Outcast Scouts, 6 Outcast Marauders, and 8 Outcast Necromancers then return to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

quests.name: Return to Orgrul
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and report back to Orgrul near the northern entrance to Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Khan Jehn
quests.objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn.
